articles.title: Groupe ADP third-quarter revenue exceeds consensus estimates
articles.summary: Investing.com - Shares of Groupe ADP were lower in mid-morning trading on Friday, despite the manager of three of Paris’ main airports posting better-than-anticipated revenue in the third quarter.
